message: I want to understand a household budget before choosing a savings target. My take-home pay is about 2,400 euros per month, and my fixed bills total 1,350 euros. I think groceries cost around 300 euros, but that is only an estimate. I have not included travel or irregular expenses yet. Please do not treat the remainder as guaranteed savings.
